title: Dropping a successive encoded slice
statement: For natural numbers $a,k,i$ and bit strings $x,u$, let $L=a(|x|+1)^k$. Applying the slice-drop operation to the encoding of $x$ paired with $u$ after its first $iL$ bits have been removed gives the encoding of $x$ paired with $u$ after its first $(i+1)L$ bits have been removed.
